label: copy phase, recalling original tokens 3-5 (mid-copy)
explanation: Fires only during the copy phase (never in the original or delimiter phases), concentrated on steps outputting original tokens 3-5 (recall_idx 4 has a 41% firing rate and 56% of the mass, recall_idx 3 has 31% of the mass, recall_idx 5 has 10%). Strongest in sequences with L=5-7, near the end of the copy (1-2 outputs left). It is almost silent at recall_idx 0-2 and 6-8. Within that window it fires on only about a quarter of steps. Which ones depends on token identity in a diffuse way: lift is mildly higher when the output is 2/h/i/r/l and the input is m/p/r/k, but token sets did not improve F1. The top activations (~2.0) tend to fall at recall_idx 3-4 with a digit or m output. The predicate captures 97% of activation mass at 26% precision.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the previous input (most: p, m, i, 1, j, h; least: c, q, <DEL>, w) and the input two steps back (most: k, j, a, r, m, p; least: g, q, <DEL>, x); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=4, recall_idx=3, L=4 & t=6.
